title: A repro the backlog check refuses is refused when the bug is filed
goal: backlog.py new bug and set --repro refuse a repro that backlog.py check refuses (a program other than python3 on a _tools/ script or inline code, such as python3 -I or grep), naming bl_intake.check_program_refusal's reason, so a bug a worker files never stops the landing's sync gate (SP-yojt6y7v: ST-zdfghdlb's and ST-t67jhly3's landings stopped at backlog.py check on five worker-filed repros).
